title: L-band jamming from the spectrum, clock holdover and a Galileo-only fallback
label: MODELLED composition of existing scenario kinds. Every number is read from a real run of the named kind; the chaining (additive carry of a channel across a phase boundary, zero-order hold onto the timeline grid, a phase ended at a computed time) is a modelling choice, and each phase carries the label of the kind that produced it.

alarm.label: alarm flag: 1 while any monitor of the phase alarms

reproducibility.runs_total.note: member scenario runs the campaign dispatched

seed.note: campaign seed: the default Monte Carlo base seed and the seed of every bootstrap resampling

timeline.channels.alarm.values[].note: alarm flag: 1 while any monitor of the phase alarms on the timeline grid: the latest sample of the owning phase's run at or before each grid time (zero-order hold); null where no run of that phase provides it

timeline.channels.alert_limit_m.values[].note: vertical alert limit on the timeline grid: the latest sample of the owning phase's run at or before each grid time (zero-order hold); null where no run of that phase provides it

timeline.channels.cn0_e1_dbhz.values[].note: cn0_e1_dbhz on the timeline grid: the latest sample of the owning phase's run at or before each grid time (zero-order hold); null where no run of that phase provides it

timeline.channels.cn0_floor_dbhz.values[.note: tracking-loss floor of the receiver on the timeline grid: the latest sample of the owning phase's run at or before each grid time (zero-order hold); null where no run of that phase provides it

timeline.channels.cn0_l1ca_dbhz.values[].note: cn0_l1ca_dbhz on the timeline grid: the latest sample of the owning phase's run at or before each grid time (zero-order hold); null where no run of that phase provides it

timeline.channels.guard_ns.values[].note: time-error guard (the run's own threshold) on the timeline grid: the latest sample of the owning phase's run at or before each grid time (zero-order hold); null where no run of that phase provides it

timeline.channels.protection_level_m.val.note: vertical protection level on the timeline grid: the latest sample of the owning phase's run at or before each grid time (zero-order hold); null where no run of that phase provides it

timeline.channels.time_error_ns.values[].note: clock time error on the timeline grid: the latest sample of the owning phase's run at or before each grid time (zero-order hold); null where no run of that phase provides it

timeline.duration_s.note: mission length: the sum of the phase lengths as run

timeline.events[].t_s.note: mission time of the event, read from the run that raised it

timeline.handoffs[].value.note: the number written into the phase's scenario, after scale and offset

timeline.phases[].carried.time_error_ns.note: value of time_error_ns at the end of the previous phase, added to this phase's time_error_ns

timeline.phases[].runs[].skip_s.note: seconds of the run's own timeline dropped before phase time zero

timeline.phases[].t0_s.note: mission time at which the phase starts (the previous phase's end)

timeline.phases[].t1_s.note: mission time at which the phase ends: t0_s plus duration_s, or earlier when end_at fired

timeline.step_s.note: grid spacing of the aligned mission timeline

timeline.t_s[].note: mission time of each grid sample
